purpose: Sign in or create an account with as little typing as possible.
layout: App logo and a one-line welcome, social sign-in buttons first, a divider, then email field and continue; terms in small text at the bottom.

optional: Switch between sign in and sign up

avoid: Tab bar on the sign-in screen

variants.layout: Logo, welcome line, social buttons, divider, email field, continue.
Photo or illustration top half, then a sheet with the sign-in options.
Minimal: large headline asking for the email, single field, continue, social options below as small buttons.
